ev-rotate.lost.say: Email support@evalation.ai and we will switch that machine off.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-clock.say: Set this machine's clock to the right time, then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-key-store.say: Check this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac) is unlocked, then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-other.say: Contact support@evalation.ai and we will fix it.

ev-rotate.not-finished.say: Other Evalation commands on this machine may not work until it finishes.

ev-rotate.not-finished-clock.say: Set this machine's clock to the right time, then run /ev-rotate again to finish it.

ev-rotate.not-finished-unreachable.say: Check this machine is online, then run /ev-rotate again to finish it.

ev-rotate.not-finished-key-store.say: Check this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac) is unlocked, then run /ev-rotate again to finish it.

ev-rotate.not-finished-twice.say: Contact support@evalation.ai and we will finish it.

ev-rotate.no-settings.say: This machine is not signed in to Evalation yet. Run /ev-activate first.

ev-rotate.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged, so the key was not replaced. Run /ev-activate to sign in again.

ev-rotate.unclear.say: Evalation could not read this machine's sign-in, so the key was not replaced. Unlock this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac), then run /ev-rotate again. If it still fails, contact support@evalation.ai.

ev-rotate.no-key.say: Part of this machine's Evalation sign-in cannot be read, so the key was not replaced. Contact support@evalation.ai and we will fix it.
